description:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten – Echoes of Space

Exploring the forgotten legacy of space exploration by discovering spacecraft, rovers, and scientific equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Our project aims to uncover their stories, missions, discoveries, and contributions to science, reminding the world that even abandoned technology continues to be part of humanity's journey into space.
summary:
Space Time Capsule is an educational website developed by Team Chakravyuham for NASA's Discarded Equipment Storytelling challenge. It explores the stories of human-made equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. The site addresses the challenge by documenting and sharing the purpose, mission background, scientific contribution and known status of these objects in an accessible digital format, using NASA data and resources.
The website features an artifact collection with Moon and Mars categories, a mission timeline, an Apollo landing-site map, NASA research resources, a space exploration quiz and an equipment-matching activity. These features make learning about space exploration more visual, engaging and accessible.
Our goal is to turn left-behind space hardware into meaningful stories, helping students and space enthusiasts understand that even after a mission ends, its discoveries, technology and legacy continue to inspire future exploration.
